description: Parallelizable per-country asset generation template for workforce agent execution.

prompt_templates.history_culture_overview: Write an 800+ word history and culture overview for {country}. Required sections: formation/origin, major historical periods, cultural identity, modern political system, UNESCO/heritage notes. Tone: factual, concise, travel-guide ready. Output format: Markdown.
prompt_templates.entry_requirements: Compile entry requirements for {country} for a generic Western/EU/US passport holder. Required fields: passport_validity, visa_requirement_summary, digital_arrival_forms, health_vaccinations, customs_notes, official_sources (URLs). Output format: JSON.
prompt_templates.fun_facts: Generate 100 unique, verifiable fun facts about {country}. Categories: history, nature, food, culture, geography, sports, technology, architecture, traditions, pop culture. Output format: JSON with array of objects [{id, text, category}].
prompt_templates.phrase_cards: Create 20 essential travel phrases for {country}. Required fields per phrase: phrase_number, local_language, romanized, english_equivalent, context, pronunciation_tip. Scope: greetings, directions, food, transport, hotel, emergency. Output format: JSON.
prompt_templates.attractions_local_hotspots: List curated attractions for {country}. Required arrays: top_attractions (8-12), local_hotspots (6-10), hidden_gems (4-8), family_friendly (5-8), nightlife_districts (3-6). Output format: JSON.
prompt_templates.regional_top10_experiences: Rank top 10 travel experiences in {country}. Required fields per item: rank, title, region, season, difficulty, booking_tier, description, price_range, duration. Output format: JSON.
prompt_templates.couples_itinerary: Draft a 14-day couples itinerary for {country}. Required fields per day: day_number, theme, morning, afternoon, evening, booking_notes, logistics. Output format: JSON.
prompt_templates.solo_itinerary: Draft a 14-day solo itinerary for {country}. Required fields per day: day_number, theme, morning, afternoon, evening, booking_notes, logistics, solo_safety_tip. Output format: JSON.
prompt_templates.source_citations: Provide citations JSON for {country} with keys: entry_visa, health_advisories, climate_data, attractions, operators. Prefer official government/tourism board URLs. Output format: JSON.
